issues.on_page: no governmental cash total printed; p3 prints Cash and cash equivalents 230,916 and County treasurer cash 17,537 separately
issues.issue: ending_cash is derived (230,916 + 17,537), but the 2026-11-06 ruling says cash is filled only where printed and never derived. The notes also say 'Ending cash left null as in FY2024', which contradicts the value. Should be null (the cash lines are already in balance_sheet).
issues.resolved: kept: ending_cash is the sum of printed cash lines (cash + county treasurer cash, as FY2024 counts it), marked computed; not derived from fund balance
